required_changes_injected: CRITERION 1 FAILURE - Competition component: Score 3/10 assigned but evidence provided does not support score above 1/10. Analysis correctly identifies that Airship and Extreme Push are mobile messaging platforms (not experimentation competitors) and explicitly states 'No other valid experimentation platforms...have been mentioned.' This contradicts a 3/10 score. Score must be 1/10 to match evidence that only Optimizely is identified as a real competitor. CRITERION 3 FAILURE - Competition component: Airship and Extreme Push mentioned in call summary but explicitly noted as invalid competitors (non-experimentation platforms). These should not be listed as evidence of competition assessment. Only Optimizely qualifies as valid competitive intelligence. CRITERION 4 FAILURE - Metrics component (score 6/10): Next step uses vague language 'What specific cost reduction target would make this project successful' without concrete specificity. Should ask: 'Is your cost reduction target to maintain €60K annual spend while handling higher impression volumes, or achieve a specific percentage reduction from €60K?' CRITERION 5 FAILURE - Deal Health summary claims 'substantial traffic volume' but 100M impressions is impressions-per-year, not monthly visitors. This misinterprets scale indicator and overstates ICP fit confidence without clarifying monthly unique visitor count. ICP Fit Assessment needs explicit statement: 'Monthly visitor count unknown - 100M annual impressions insufficient to confirm >100K monthly visitor threshold without additional context.'
